notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak,
Scurry Oak's second ability and Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Squirrel token, causing you to mill Moss-Pit Skeleton from the top of your library.
The Wise Mothman's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.
